Definition: to pluck off or pull to pieces; causatively to supply with food (as in morsels)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to tear, rend, pluck; 1a) (Qal) to tear, rend; 1b) (Niphal) to be torn in pieces; 1c) (Poal) to be torn in pieces; 1d) (Hiphil) to provide food
